title: Neobit rule registry
description: Rules loaded by the neobit MCP server. Edit this file to add or change a rule; no rebuild is needed.

id.description: Stable identifier. Reusing an id in a project file overrides the shared rule.

category.description: Groups the rule in list_standards, e.g. 'Frontend & Mobile', 'Backend & AI', 'Universal'.

description.description: Also used as the violation message when the rule is enforced, so write it as the thing to fix.

enabled.description: Set false in a project file to switch an inherited rule off.

check.description: Omit for guidance that cannot be checked mechanically; the rule is then documentation-only.

pattern.description: JavaScript regex source. A file matching it is reported.

skipFile.description: Regex over the file path; matching files are exempt (e.g. the theme layer for colour rules).

requiresAbsent.description: Only report when this pattern is absent from the file — lets a rule stand down when the correct API is already in use.
